canon_ref.note: In the empty inn he checks no one is near, noting Magnolia's [Assassins] and [Scouts] hidden miles to the east. He offers Soldiers to guard the inn and will lie to his Queen for them. Keep all of this out of news.

b2.klbkch_shares_hive_secrets_with_ryoka.summary: Klbkch tells Ryoka he knows she and Erin come from another world and hides it from his Queen. He shares Hive secrets: Listeners, six Queens under a Grand Queen, a God waking in Rhir that the Antinium fled, and Teriarch burning two of their armies.

canon_ref.note: Ryoka hopes the secret could pay the 50,000 gold debt. The park's playground is kept safe by spells a Wistram mage renews each year. Klbkch will check his Hive's records.

b2.ryoka_explains_the_level_cap_theory.summary: Ryoka argues that levels are capped by the total across all of a person's classes, not by age, so extra classes stall the main one. Klbkch, far below his old peak, finds it fits; Selys, told at a warded playground, swears to keep it secret.

system.name: [Swordslayer]
system.note: Secret, told to Ryoka. At his peak he was Level 44 [Swordslayer].
